name: Folded Sanctuary
summary: A broad cut-paper dome meets a stepped square minaret, with a deep horseshoe doorway and one folded corner.
why: The main dome and doorway share x=61. The tower is part of the same outer path and ends on the same y=75 foundation as the hall. The doorway crown is three units below the dome spring line. The warm lower fold follows the actual right wall and does not add a separate object.
risk: The asymmetry is deliberate: a heavy dome balances the slim tower. The horseshoe opening does most of the identifying work in monochrome.
sub2: Depth from one simple paper shape
reasonToChoose: You want a clear mosque silhouette shaped through broad paper planes and generous openings.
